camel_example: aliyun rtc DescribeChannelUsers --region cn-hangzhou --AppId 'a2hz****' --ChannelId testId --version 2018-01-11 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries the list of real-time online users in a channel
description_zh: 查询 Channel（频道）实时在线用户列表
name: DescribeChannelUsers

parameters.help_en: The application ID. You can create and query the ID in the console. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 应用ID，通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the channel to query. Only a single ID is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的频道ID，仅支持传单个ID
parameters.name: channel_id

ChannelProfile.description_en:
The channel mode. Valid values:

1: Communication (communication mode).

2: Interactive_live (live streaming mode)
ChannelProfile.description_zh:
频道模式，取值：

1：Communication（通信模式）。

2：Interactive_live（直播模式）

CommTotalNum.description_en: The total number of users in the channel in communication mode. If the channel is not in communication mode, this parameter is 0
CommTotalNum.description_zh: 通信模式下频道内的用户总数，如果频道为非通信模式，该参数为0

InteractiveUserList.description_en: The list of interactive user IDs in the channel in live streaming mode. This parameter is empty if the channel is not in live streaming mode
InteractiveUserList.description_zh: 直播模式下频道内互动用户的 ID 列表；非直播模式下为空

items.description_en: The list of interactive users in the channel in live streaming mode. This parameter is empty if the channel is not in live streaming mode
items.description_zh: 直播模式下频道内的互动用户列表，如果频道为非直播模式，该参数为空

InteractiveUserNum.description_en: The total number of interactive users in the channel in live streaming mode. If the channel is not in live streaming mode, this parameter is 0
InteractiveUserNum.description_zh: 直播模式下频道内的互动者用户总数，如果频道为非直播模式，该参数为0

IsChannelExist.description_en:
Indicates whether the channel exists. Valid values:
true: The channel exists.

false: The channel does not exist
IsChannelExist.description_zh:
频道是否存在，取值：
true：存在。

false：不存在

LiveUserList.description_en: The list of viewer IDs in the channel in live streaming mode. A maximum of 1,000 viewers are returned. This parameter is empty if the channel is not in live streaming mode
LiveUserList.description_zh: 直播模式下频道内观众的 ID 列表，最多返回前 1000 人；非直播模式下为空

items.description_en: The list of viewers in the channel in live streaming mode. Only the first 1,000 viewers are returned. This parameter is empty if the channel is not in live streaming mode
items.description_zh: 直播模式下频道内的观众列表，只返回前1000人，如果频道为非直播模式，该参数为空

LiveUserNum.description_en: The total number of viewers in the channel in live streaming mode. If the channel is not in live streaming mode, this parameter is 0
LiveUserNum.description_zh: 直播模式下频道内的观众总数，如果频道为非直播模式，该参数为0

Timestamp.description_en: The timestamp of the current time in UTC
Timestamp.description_zh: 当前时刻的时间戳（UTC时间）

UserList.description_en: The list of user IDs in the channel in communication mode. This parameter is empty if the channel is not in communication mode
UserList.description_zh: 通信模式下频道内用户的 ID 列表；非通信模式下为空

items.description_en: The list of users in the channel in communication mode. This parameter is empty if the channel is not in communication mode
items.description_zh: 通信模式下频道的用户列表，如果频道为非通信模式，该参数为空
